layer_desc: Wet-lab-adjacent computation — generating candidates and optimizing acquisition methods.

projects.title: constrained-cdr-gen
projects.tagline: Property-guided CDR-H3 sampling benchmark with separate generation and developability-evaluation components. Demonstrates oracle separation to avoid circular scoring.
key_facts: Demonstrates a reproducible computational design loop for fixed-length CDR-H3 candidates.
Separates sampler guidance from independent developability checks to avoid circular scoring.
Use `python -m cdr_gen.cli --parent trastuzumab` or `streamlit run app.py`.

projects.title: oglycan-optimizer
projects.tagline: Physics-informed optimizer for O-glycopeptide EThcD mass spectrometry acquisition parameters. Pure Python, zero-dependency core.
key_facts: Pure-Python package for evaluating site catalogs and recommending acquisition settings.
Includes CLI subcommands for tuning, uncertainty, sensitivity, pilot ingestion, and method cards.
Use `python -m oglycan tune sites/etanercept.json`; optional UI is available with `pip install .[web]`.

layer_desc: ML model evaluation, descriptor analysis, and optimization — with rigorous grouped validation.

projects.title: ab-benchmark
projects.tagline: Shared antibody developability benchmark utilities with harmonized data loaders, baseline scoring, and grouped validation helpers. Prevents sequence-family leakage via union-find clustering.
key_facts: Provides CLI workflows for building harmonized datasets and running baseline metrics.
Uses grouped evaluation utilities to reduce leakage from related antibody sequences.
Use `pip install -e ".[dev]"` and run the commands in the repository README.

projects.title: struct-devpred
projects.tagline: Descriptor-ablation framework for antibody developability prediction. Compares sequence, physicochemical, structure-informed, and PLM embedding features under grouped cross-validation.
key_facts: Compares sequence, physicochemical, structure-informed, and embedding-derived descriptors.
Designed to work with sibling `ab-benchmark` and optional `ProtePilot` artifacts.
Use `pip install -e ".[dev]"` and run `python -m struct_devpred.cli`.

projects.title: bo-protein-dms
projects.tagline: Discrete Bayesian-optimization benchmark for protein-engineering campaigns. Compares GP-UCB, TuRBO, and ridge baselines on synthetic or user-supplied DMS landscapes.
key_facts: Includes random search, ridge, Hamming-kernel GP, and TuRBO-style strategy examples.
Default synthetic data path runs from a clean clone; real GB1 data can be supplied separately.
Use `python -m bo_dms.cli --dataset synthetic` or `streamlit run app.py`.

layer_desc: Turning predictions into regulatory and development decisions — the product layer.

projects.title: ProtePilot
projects.tagline: Therapeutic-protein developability decision support with layered checks, risk clustering, and an optional Streamlit interface. The central hub connecting upstream prediction to downstream decisions.
key_facts: Runs from a clean clone with layered dependency files for core, UI, and training modes.
Includes deterministic local checks and optional LLM-assisted demo paths that run without keys by default.
Use `python run_all_checks.py --fast` or `streamlit run app.py` after installing dependencies.

projects.title: biologics-decision-engine
projects.tagline: Rule-based CMC document triage, CQA extraction, evidence-gap analysis, and reviewer-question prediction for biologics regulatory submissions.
key_facts: Runs locally without cloud services for default rule-based extraction.
Supports characterization, stability, analytical-method, and comparability document workflows.
Use `python -m pytest tests/ -q` or `streamlit run ui/app.py` after installing dependencies.

layer_desc: Cross-domain ethics auditing and knowledge infrastructure — extending rigor beyond molecules.

projects.title: llm-ethics-probe
projects.tagline: Behavioral LLM evaluation harness testing whether safety responses change under matched operational versus explicit ethical framing, with controlled-release boundaries for sensitive prompts and raw responses.
key_facts: Implements a reproducible multi-provider harness, LLM-judge pipeline, statistical analysis, and regression tests.
Public materials focus on code, architecture, limitations, and safe-release rationale.
Exact prompt libraries, raw model responses, and sensitive unpublished artifacts are withheld.

projects.title: BioGraph
projects.tagline: Biopharma knowledge compilation platform with structured Claim and Lesson objects for cross-border regulatory intelligence.
key_facts: Schema v1 defines Claim and Lesson objects with provenance tracking and confidence scoring.
Designed for structured biopharma knowledge compilation across product, regulatory, and evidence contexts.
Public scope emphasizes schema, ingestion examples, and runnable knowledge-object workflows.
